scope: Pune-to-curated Maharashtra and Goa beaches: Maharashtra-side northern Trimbak–Jawhar alternative through all confirmed documented plateau–Konkan corridors, plus Goa gateways and neighboring Anashi–Karwar approach to Canacona. Excludes a Gujarat coastal excursion and more southerly Karnataka beach excursions by destination-catchment rule, not arbitrary latitude or maximum detour.
completeness: Complete itinerary coverage of the 19 explicitly enumerated confirmed documented-road baseline corridors. This is not a universal discovery or current-opening claim. Proposed/unconfirmed direct links and historic walking passes are individually dispositioned.

baseline.eligibility: Official modern road/visitor-access evidence plus connected OSM car geometry. Gazetteer-only historic trails are not assumed modern roads. Public corridor identity is distinct from current opening.
baseline.northernRule: Include the documented Maharashtra-side Trimbak–Jawhar connection rather than stopping at Kasara; Gujarat/Daman-facing routes are outside the selected coastal catchment.
baseline.southernRule: Include neighboring Anashi–Kadra–Karwar as a direct south-Goa approach; do not extend to unrelated Karnataka beach destinations.

networkAudit: OSRM car graph tested for each included entry/interior/exit corridor; ferry and collapsed-snap rejection; main-road anchor refinement. Specific proposed/foot-pass audits retained in candidate-road-audit.json. No complete every-road GIS cut-line or field survey is claimed.

specificBlockedClaims.reason: The IMD-located Namkhol road point snaps to District Highway 76, but the car response returns over the same 2.1km spur before reaching the connected Mirvel road. Pargad–Mirvel is included on the PWD SH187 baseline; a direct downhill Namkhol spur connection is not invented. This is a graph-link limitation, not a declaration that the public road is legally closed.

Historic pass is explicitly foot/pack-only in the official Gazetteer. The 2016–17 PWD item451 is a border-road construction provision, not a completion/opening certificate. The constrained car audit requires35.9km through the NH748AA/Chorla-side network between sides only5.0km apart, rather than a direct pass crossing. The modern connector remains outside the confirmed motor-road baseline until continuous public-car eligibility and a corresponding graph connection are evidenced; waterfall approach alone does not qualify.

candidates.name: Peth–Dharampur / Surgana–Dangs northern passes
candidates.rationale: The official geographic inventory places these corridors on Gujarat/Daman-facing routes, rather than the Maharashtra-side Trimbak–Jawhar coastal connection now included. The documented-road baseline follows Maharashtra-side outlets to the selected Maharashtra coast and direct bordering approaches to Goa; it does not add a Gujarat coastal excursion before returning to Maharashtra. This is an explicit catchment/state-corridor relevance rule, not a latitude or maximum-detour cutoff.

candidates.rationale: Official tourism describes the historic pass as a trek. This does not claim that every nearby local road was field-surveyed.
